name: QA-1124-DUP-01: A name edited to an existing business or merchant after Add New is still refused
description:
Objective: QA-1124-DUP-01: A name edited to an existing business or merchant after Add New is still refused.
Preconditions: Open Bug regressions application with the configured test data.
Steps:
1. Open Bug regressions application.
2. QA-1124-DUP-01: A name edited to an existing business or merchant after Add New is still refused.
3. Observe the resulting state.
Expected: Type an existing name with its last letter missing, click Add New, then complete the name to match the existing record exactly. Saving must be refused as a duplicate. Every create request is aborted, so no record is created even when the check is missing.
